description: This file defines the MyTimesheetItemAPI class, which provides API endpoints for listing and updating a user's timesheet entries in the OrangeHRM system. It includes annotations for OpenAPI documentation and operates as a PHP class extending EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI, with methods for retrieving timesheet data with authorization checks.

classes.name: MyTimesheetItemAPI
classes.description: API class for managing a user's timesheet entries, including retrieving and updating timesheet data with access control.

methods.name: getTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves a timesheet by ID from the request parameters, checks if the current user has permission to access it, and returns the Timesheet object.
